summary: Reinitializes the 6-dword global array dword_8AC36C to the literal state { 0, -1, 0, 0, 0, 0 } (index 1 set to -1 as the only non-zero entry), then invokes SceneListCleanup() and returns a pointer to the reinitialized array.

operations.description: Write the initial state into dword_8AC36C: dword_8AC36C[0] = 0, dword_8AC36C[1] = -1, dword_8AC36C[2] = 0, dword_8AC36C[3] = 0, dword_8AC36C[4] = 0, dword_8AC36C[5] = 0; index 1 is the only non-zero entry, set to -1 as a sentinel.

Return the pointer to the reinitialized dword_8AC36C buffer.
